title: Catalogue raisonne entry, version 1
description: The document of a CATALOGUE_ENTRY statement: the artist's catalogue entry for one work. A later entry superseding it replaces it. Rules: docs/spec/declarations-and-conventions.md (DCL-16, DCL-17).

catalogueNumber.description: The artist's own number for the work, unique within the artist's catalogue.

date.description: When the work was made: a year, a year and month, or a date (ISO 8601), or a range of two such values joined by a slash.

physicalTwin.description: The custodian's object ID of the work's physical twin, as the declarations document names it.
